summary: Cefixime is an oral third-generation cephalosporin antibiotic for adults and children 6 months and older. It treats susceptible urinary, ear, throat, bronchial and gonococcal infections by blocking bacterial cell-wall synthesis. Usual adult dose is 400 mg once daily.
indications: Uncomplicated urinary tract infections (E. coli, P. mirabilis)
Otitis media (H. influenzae, M. catarrhalis, S. pyogenes)

dosage.n: May give with or without food
Tablets not bioequivalent to suspension for otitis media

admin: Take once daily, with or without food
For suspension, always confirm concentration (100, 200 or 500 mg/5 mL)
Separate dose by route per renal status
moa: Semisynthetic cephalosporin that binds penicillin-binding proteins, inhibiting bacterial cell-wall synthesis and producing a bactericidal effect against susceptible organisms.

absolute: Known allergy to cefixime or other cephalosporins
relative: History of penicillin/beta-lactam allergy (cross-reactivity up to ~10%)

preg: Observational data show no established drug-associated risk; no fetal harm in animal studies.
lact: No human-milk data; present in animal milk — use with caution.
renal: Normal dose if CrCl >=60 mL/min; reduce dose if <60 mL/min; not significantly dialyzable.
hepatic: No specific dosage adjustment in the label.

major: Warfarin/anticoagulants — increased prothrombin time, with or without bleeding
interactions.food: May be taken with or without food (food slightly delays absorption).
interactions.diagnostics: False-positive urine glucose (Clinitest/Benedict's/Fehling's), urine ketones (nitroprusside), and direct Coombs test possible.

emergency: Severe or bloody diarrhea suggesting C. difficile colitis

monitoring: Watch for diarrhea during and after therapy (C. difficile)
Prothrombin time when co-administered with anticoagulants
counsel: Take exactly as prescribed and finish the full course
Report any rash, swelling or breathing difficulty immediately
Report watery or bloody diarrhea, even weeks after stopping
Tell your doctor about any penicillin or cephalosporin allergy
Shake liquid well and use the supplied measuring device
pk: 3 to 4 hours (up to 9 h); prolonged in renal impairment
pearls: Single 400 mg oral dose is the labeled regimen for uncomplicated cervical/urethral gonorrhea
About 40-50% oral absorption regardless of food
Tablets and suspension are NOT bioequivalent — do not substitute for otitis media
Cross-reactivity may occur in up to ~10% of penicillin-allergic patients
Not significantly removed by hemodialysis or peritoneal dialysis
missed: Take as soon as remembered; skip if near next dose. Do not double.
overdose: No specific antidote; gastric lavage may help. Not significantly removed by dialysis. Supportive care.
refs: U.S. FDA label via openFDA / DailyMed
